mof_ops.detail: Only one switch held in the windows (18 Mar, above). The 11 Mar switch had been cancelled pre-window (SPW volatility; Czarnecki: MoF liquid buffer >160bn). The 18 Mar sale was replaced by the switch, so only ONE regular sale auction (25 Mar) took place in March. No T-bill auctions planned in March (plan of 27 Feb); no buyback outside the switch. MoF DB shows no other wholesale operations 1-31 Mar.

Q1 plan (31 Dec 2025, pre-window): 8 sale auctions PLN 75-100bn + 1 switch. Regular sale supply incl. additional sales (MoF DB, derived): Jan 41,567.7m; Feb ~40,859.4m (11/18/25 Feb); Mar 25 Mar 7,692.2m only = ~90.1bn in 7 sale auctions (18 Mar converted to switch); switch 18 Mar: +9,476.2 sold / -9,170.7 bought back (net +305.6m). Financing of 2026 gross needs: ~38% (25 Feb) -> ~41% (25 Mar, MoF). Domanski (16 Mar): MoF will track yields and adjust its actions to market levels; he cited a PLN 170bn liquidity cushion (number first dated in PAP 23 Mar 06:34). April supply plan and Q2 financing plan: scheduled for Tue 31 Mar 15:00 (PAP calendar 30 Mar 06:34) - NOT published by 30 Mar, so not used. Q2 plan / April plan content OUTSIDE windows.
